item.title: Apache Hop 2.18.1 is available!!
item.description: The Apache Hop community is excited to announce the release of Apache Hop 2.18.1! This is a patch release to address some regressions that have happened between 2.17.0 and 2.18.0. The following issues have been solved: Text file input no longer returned row numbers if configured to return those Merge Rows (diff) regression with row lay-out Get file names filter on type (files/Folders) did not work anymore
